title: Agent Capability Expansion Master Roadmap
goal: Give Odysseus agents safe senses and a bounded sandbox so they can inspect websites, execute code, observe results, and write reviewed knowledge into Memory/RaptorGraph.

target_user_story.example_request: analysiere die asv bw hilfeseite vollstaendig und fasse alle informationen im gedaechtnis zusammen
expected_flow: Telegram receives a trusted operator request.
Odysseus classifies it as web research plus memory synthesis.
Browser worker crawls the approved site with bounded depth and page count.
Worker captures DOM, accessibility tree, text, screenshots, console and network evidence.
Research pipeline deduplicates and summarizes findings without storing raw private content.
Memory/RaptorGraph write intent is generated with source refs and review policy.
If gates allow, redacted abstractions are written to long-term memory and RaptorGraph.
must_not_do: No bypass of robots or login walls without operator approval.
No raw page dumps in memory.
No API model receives sensitive content when DSGVO/local-only policy applies.
No host shell access from the browser worker.

capability_lanes.name: Browser Sense
capability_lanes.done_when: Agent can inspect approved pages through DOM, accessibility tree, screenshot, console and network evidence in a redacted report.

capability_lanes.name: Sandbox Pod Runtime
capability_lanes.done_when: Odysseus can dispatch bounded jobs to an isolated Podman pod with no default secrets, scoped mounts, resource limits and audited artifacts.

capability_lanes.name: Result Observer
capability_lanes.done_when: Agents can verify code/UI outcomes with tests, logs, screenshots, DOM diffs, traces and artifact summaries without GPU.

capability_lanes.name: Telegram Web Research To Memory
capability_lanes.done_when: A Telegram request can trigger bounded website analysis and produce reviewed Memory/RaptorGraph write intents.

execution_order: ACE-2 sandbox pod contract and dry-run job model
ACE-1 plus ACE-2 local read-only smoke
ACE-4 Telegram workflow binding and memory write intent
Live smokes under active thread goal approval on Debian after local tests

global_gate_queue.decision_needed: Allow creation/start of a Podman sandbox pod on the Debian host.
global_gate_queue.risk_if_bypassed: Agent jobs could run outside audited isolation.

global_gate_queue.decision_needed: Allow bounded web access for approved target domains.
global_gate_queue.risk_if_bypassed: Unapproved network crawling or accidental data transfer.

global_gate_queue.decision_needed: Allow reviewed abstractions to be written to native Memory and RaptorGraph.
global_gate_queue.risk_if_bypassed: Unreviewed or low-quality knowledge could become long-term truth.

global_gate_queue.decision_needed: UI agent decides where sandbox jobs, traces, screenshots and memory write reviews live.

non_goals: No Docker MCP or Docker-first runtime.
No UI implementation in this roadmap set.
success_metrics: Browser evidence report contains DOM, accessibility, screenshot, console and network summaries.
Sandbox pod jobs are resource bounded and disposable.
Visual observer works with headless Chromium software rendering.
Website-to-memory workflow produces source-linked abstractions, not raw crawled pages.
All live gates are explicit and auditable.
